title: AcaTime CISS-2026 artifact: rule-aware incremental evaluation and validation logs
description: Exact AcaTime genetic-algorithm source snapshot, local runner, public ITC 2019 bridge tools, 17 anonymized faculty-scale validation runs with sanitized logs and aggregate checks, and a curated development section for the engineering before/after measurements. Raw faculty data, schedules and production logs are not included. Code is Apache-2.0; data, logs and documentation are CC BY 4.0.
